params.name: aliasPath
params.description: Name or access path of the alias/shortcut to resolve.

params.name: targetPath
params.description: Receives the full path to the alias/shortcut's target file or folder.

overloads.semanticRole: Resolves aliasPath to the full path of the file or folder it points to, writing the result into targetPath.

constraints: Sets the OK system variable to 1 when aliasPath was a genuine alias/shortcut successfully resolved.
If aliasPath is actually a plain file (not an alias/shortcut), targetPath returns that file's own path and OK is set to 0.
